chat.pageIntro: Ask about your booking, the estimated refund if you cancel, or property rules.
chat.disclosure: You are chatting with an AI assistant. It cannot approve refunds, cancellations or payments; when needed it hands the conversation to our human support team.
chat.label: Your message
chat.hint: Do not share personal data (ID number, card, IBAN).
chat.handoff: Handed over to our human support team. Ticket no: {id}.
chat.humanMessage: I would like to talk to a human agent.
chat.humanHint: If the AI answer is not enough, you can hand the conversation straight to our human support team.
chat.humanPending: Your request was forwarded to our human support team. An agent will reply to the email address on your account; you can follow the ticket status in the list at the top of this page.
chat.bookingNone: None selected (your nearest booking is used)
chat.thinking: The assistant is preparing a reply…
chat.standaloneHint: The assistant answers each message on its own and does not remember earlier ones; ask your full question in one message.
chat.suggestTitle: Start with a ready-made question (it is sent as soon as you choose it):

suggest.bookingStatus: What is the status of my booking?
suggest.cancellationQuote: If I cancel now, how much will I get back?
suggest.checkInTimes: What are the check-in and check-out times?

chat.shortcutHint: Press Ctrl+Enter (⌘+Enter on Mac) to send.
chat.nearLimit: Messages can be at most {max} characters; you are close to the limit.
chat.truncated: The pasted text did not fit; your message was cut to {max} characters.
chat.prefillAccessibility: {hasProperty, select, yes {I have a question about the accessibility of “{property}”: } other {I have a question about a property’s accessibility: }}

admin.pageIntro: Tickets the AI support assistant handed over to humans. Decisions are made by a human agent.
admin.title: Support tickets
admin.search: Search by ticket, booking or user ID
admin.selectedCount: {count, plural, one {# ticket selected} other {# tickets selected}}
admin.bulkUpdated: {count, plural, one {# ticket updated.} other {# tickets updated.}}
admin.bulkFailed: {count, plural, one {# ticket} other {# tickets}} could not be updated: {error}
admin.groupTitle: {count, plural, one {# ticket} other {# tickets}} for the same booking
